name: The Toledo Club (1915, NRHP), 235 14th St
refs: refs/w8000113836/00 (Toledo Club front and western side, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Georgian Revival clubhouse: rusticated limestone ground floor, red-brick upper storeys with limestone quoins, tall round-arched piano-nobile windows with balconettes, a bowed bay on the front, limestone balustraded cornice.
